message.villagershop.trade_fail: Out of stock or you can't afford it.
book.villagershop.guide.name: VillagerShop Guide
book.villagershop.guide.landing: Welcome! This guide explains how to set up and run your villager-operated shop.
book.villagershop.guide.cat.desc: Everything you need to create and run your shop.
book.villagershop.guide.e1.name: Getting started
book.villagershop.guide.e1.p1: Craft the $(item)Merchant Counter$() with 8 planks around an emerald.$(br2)Place it: you automatically become its $(l)owner$().
book.villagershop.guide.e2.name: The seller
book.villagershop.guide.e2.p1: Place the counter near an $(l)unemployed adult villager$().$(br2)It claims the counter and becomes your $(item)Merchant$(): the shop's storefront.
book.villagershop.guide.e2.p2: Customers $(l)right-click$() the villager to buy.$(br2)One villager per counter. Break the counter and the villager becomes normal again.
book.villagershop.guide.e3.name: Shop tab
book.villagershop.guide.e3.p1: $(l)Shop tab$() (book):$(br)- the $(o)shop name$()$(br)- the $(o)co-owners$(): type a name + Add; click a name to remove it.
book.villagershop.guide.e4.name: Trade tab
book.villagershop.guide.e4.p1: $(l)Trade tab$() (emerald): up to $(vsnum:max_offers) offers.$(br2)Only $(l)1 offer$() is unlocked at first — each $(item)$(vsitem:trades)$() placed in the Upgrades tab unlocks one more ($(vsnum:max_trade_blocks) placed = $(vsnum:max_offers) offers).$(br2)Locked offers are greyed out; their settings are kept.
book.villagershop.guide.e4.p2: $(l)Left-click$(): place a template (item not consumed).$(br)$(l)Right-click$(): clear.$(br2)The template stack size = the offer quantity.
book.villagershop.guide.e5.name: Stock tab
book.villagershop.guide.e5.p1: $(l)Stock tab$() (chest): the storage holds the $(o)goods to sell$() and the $(o)payments$() received.$(br2)If empty, the offer is out of stock.$(br2)$(l:villagershop:6_upgrade#storage)Running low on space? Expand it with the Storage upgrade.$()
book.villagershop.guide.e6.name: Upgrades
book.villagershop.guide.e6.p1: $(l)Upgrade tab$() (spectral arrow): drop items to upgrade your merchant.$(br2)Each upgrade unlocks a feature; remove the item and that feature turns off — but your settings are kept.
book.villagershop.guide.e6.p2: $(l)Immortality upgrade$() — $(item)$(vsitem:immortality)$():$(br2)the villager becomes $(l)invincible$(). Remove the upgrade to make it mortal again.
book.villagershop.guide.e6.p3: $(l)Movement upgrade$():$(br2)$(item)$(vsitem:movement)$() $(o)(tier 1)$(): stays within $(l)3 blocks$() of the counter.$(br)$(item)$(vsitem:movement_static)$() $(o)(tier 2)$(): walks in front of the counter, then stays $(l)still$().
book.villagershop.guide.e7.name: Selling
book.villagershop.guide.e7.p1: The customer clicks the villager: a standard trading screen opens.$(br2)They pay and receive the item; the payment goes into your $(o)stock$().
book.villagershop.guide.e7.p2: $(l)Out of stock$(): if the stock lacks the goods, or has no room for the payment, the offer is unavailable.$(br2)Install the $(l)Communication upgrade$() to be warned about blocked sales and merchant death.
message.villagershop.no_supply: Your shop '%s' is out of goods — a sale is blocked at %s %s %s.
message.villagershop.no_stock: Your shop '%s' storage is full — can't take payment, a sale is blocked at %s %s %s.
book.villagershop.guide.e6.p4: $(l)Storage upgrade$() — $(item)$(vsitem:storage)$():$(br2)the base counter holds $(o)$(vsnum:base_capacity)$() slots. Each one adds $(o)+$(vsnum:slots_per_chest)$(), up to $(o)$(vsnum:max_chests) placed = $(vsnum:max_capacity)$() slots. Scroll the stock list to see them all.
book.villagershop.guide.e6.p5: $(l)Communication upgrade$() — $(item)$(vsitem:communication)$():$(br2)the owner and co-owners are notified when a sale is $(l)blocked$() (out of goods, or storage full) and when the merchant $(l)dies$().$(br)Online players get it at once; others on their next login, if still relevant.$(br)It also adds a $(l)Locate merchant$() button (this tab) that shows the villager's coordinates.
message.villagershop.villager_missing: No merchant is currently assigned to this counter.
message.villagershop.no_access_module: Install the Access upgrade (gold block) to manage co-owners.
message.villagershop.cant_remove: You can't remove the owner or yourself.
book.villagershop.guide.e6.p6: $(l)Access upgrade$() — $(item)$(vsitem:access)$():$(br2)unlocks the co-owners module (Shop tab). Without it, co-owners can't be edited and lose access — the saved list is still kept. The owner can also $(l)transfer$() the shop: Shift+click a co-owner's ★ in the list.
message.villagershop.export_ok: Shop config saved to the book.
message.villagershop.export_fail: Put a Book and Quill in the save slot first.
message.villagershop.import_ok: Shop config imported. Reopen to refresh the view.
message.villagershop.import_fail: No saved config found in that book.
book.villagershop.guide.e6.p7: $(l)Memory upgrade$() — $(item)$(vsitem:memory)$():$(br2)unlocks the Save module: a $(item)Book and Quill$() slot, a $(item)Written Book$() slot and one button.$(br)Quill present → exports a $(l)signed$() save book into the second slot. Signed book present → imports its config.$(br)The signed book is $(l)copyable$() in a crafting table; copies keep the data.
message.villagershop.save_empty: Put a Book and Quill to export, or a signed save book to import.
book.villagershop.guide.e4.p1b: Each offer: set the $(o)price$() (slot 1, + optional slot 2) then the $(o)goods$() (result slot).$(br2)Leave the price empty to give the item away $(l)for free$() (still limited by stock).
book.villagershop.guide.e6.p8: $(l)Trades upgrade$() — $(item)$(vsitem:trades)$():$(br2)your counter starts with $(o)1$() offer. Each one unlocks $(o)+1$(), up to $(o)$(vsnum:max_trade_blocks) placed = $(vsnum:max_offers) offers$().$(br2)Remove some and the extra offers lock again — their settings are kept.
gui.villagershop.transfer_hint: Shift+click ★ to transfer the shop to this player
message.villagershop.transfer_fail: Transfer failed — player must be a co-owner
message.villagershop.protected: This counter belongs to someone — you can't break it
book.villagershop.guide.e6.p9: $(l)Blast protection upgrade$() — $(item)$(vsitem:blast_protection)$():$(br2)the counter resists explosions (creepers, TNT).$(br2)Note: an owned counter can only be $(l)broken$() by its owner or co-owners (creative players bypass this).
gui.villagershop.ledger.title: Sales Ledger
gui.villagershop.ledger.empty_hint: Install the Communication upgrade (lightning rod) in your counters.
gui.villagershop.ledger.col_sold_desc: §7Goods handed to customers (out of stock storage)
gui.villagershop.infinite_on: Unlimited stock: ON (admin) — goods are never taken from storage
gui.villagershop.infinite_off: Unlimited stock: OFF — click to serve this offer without consuming stock
gui.villagershop.locked_stock_keep: Over capacity: click to take this item back (into your inventory, or dropped if it's full).
book.villagershop.guide.e4.p1.one: $(l)Trade tab$() (emerald): up to 2 offers.$(br2)Only $(l)1 offer$() is unlocked at first — placing a $(item)$(vsitem:trades)$() in the Upgrades tab unlocks the second one.$(br2)A locked offer is greyed out; its settings are kept.
book.villagershop.guide.e5.p1.nostorage: $(l)Stock tab$() (chest): the storage holds the $(o)goods to sell$() and the $(o)payments$() received.$(br2)If empty, the offer is out of stock.
book.villagershop.guide.e6.p4.one: $(l)Storage upgrade$() — $(item)$(vsitem:storage)$():$(br2)the base counter holds $(o)$(vsnum:base_capacity)$() slots. Only one can be placed: the storage then grows to $(o)$(vsnum:max_capacity)$() slots. Scroll the stock list to see them all.
book.villagershop.guide.e6.p8.one: $(l)Trades upgrade$() — $(item)$(vsitem:trades)$():$(br2)your counter starts with $(o)1$() offer. Only one can be placed: it unlocks $(o)the second one$().$(br2)Remove it and that offer locks again — its settings are kept.
book.villagershop.guide.e7.p2.nocomm: $(l)Out of stock$(): if the stock lacks the goods, or has no room for the payment, the offer is unavailable.
